row.evidence: Okta's catalogue lists the Avigilon Alta app with SAML and SCIM (Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push) and Alta's API schema carries scimAccessTokens on identity providers, but Avigilon sells only by custom quote ("Get a custom quote for your security solution") and names no plan for SCIM.
row.notes: New row; Avigilon Alta Access is the former Openpath (API still at api.openpath.com). Pricing is quote-only (hardware plus software licences), with no public tiers, so the SCIM price gate cannot be determined and status stays unknown. Provisioning evidence: Okta OIN app marks SAML + SCIM with Create/Update/Deactivate/Group Push (read from page markup); Avigilon's own Okta page describes a pull-style sync every 15 minutes plus manual sync, and Entra ID and Google Workspace integrations that import and sync users; the identity-provider API object has scimAccessTokens and scimAttributeMapping fields. No public SCIM endpoint documentation; the Alta help centre (help.openpath.com) requires login. Synced IdP users can use the mobile app but not API/portal login.

operations.notes: From Okta OIN capability checkboxes (Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push), read from page markup.

limitations.text: Users synced from a third-party IdP can only use the Openpath Mobile Access app; they cannot log in to the API (and per the same note, the portal).

scim.notes: SCIM existence comes from Okta's catalogue page and SCIM fields in Alta's identity-provider API schema; no vendor SCIM guide is public.

endpoints.purpose: Set a user's status (I, A, S)

webhooks_user_events.notes: REST Hook subscriptions exist; user-event types not confirmed.

limitations.text: API calls must use Alta-native accounts, not IdP-synced identities.

okta.notes: OIN markup: SAML and SCIM checked; Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push checked. Avigilon's page describes a 15-minute sync cycle (c3).

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial in the saas-apps TOC; Avigilon's page says the Entra ID integration adds or removes users and groups, mechanism not stated.

google.notes: Vendor-run import and sync from Google Workspace described on Avigilon's page; no Google catalogue page checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: Vendor-run sync with Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID; Okta sync every 15 minutes
fallbacks.notes: API reference is public; the admin help centre (help.openpath.com) shows 'You may need to log in to access this page'.
